Summary Description: IEEE Communications Magazine • April 202548 0163-6804/25/$25.00 © 2025 IEEEAbstrAct In the evolving landscape of federated learn- ing management systems (FLMS), ensuring robust security against adversarial attacks is paramount. However, traditional methods that filter harmful updates before aggregation often fail in already compromised networks. This research introduces a pioneering approach that integrates digital twin (DT) technology with an FLMS, bolstering the net- work’s resilience and safeguarding communica- tion among distributed networks in the 6G era.
